name: DINO-enhanced NeRF
definition: A variant of NeRF that integrates pre-trained DINO vision features to enhance few-shot 3D reconstruction, specifically investigating frozen DINO features, LoRA-fine-tuned features, and multi-scale features.
summary: DINO-enhanced NeRF integrates pre-trained vision features into NeRF for few-shot 3D reconstruction, though it often underperforms the baseline due to feature-task mismatch.
